system.description: When you summon a creature as a result of a Jutsu you cast with the Lightning or Water Release keyword, by spending 2 Voltage as part of casting the triggering jutsu they surge with power, as they become pitch black and radiate with energy. For the summoned creatures duration, they gain additional hit points equal to your level, and +1 AC. This increases to +2 AC and Resistance to Earth and Fire damage at 7th level and +3 AC and Immunity to Elemental conditions at 15th level.
